surface: signal recording, metrics/traces, bounded drains, and OTLP export

findings.title: Durable model-call signals disappear when settlement stops early or the effect is not successful
findings.recommendation: Project the committed model effect before the budget-stop return and carry failed/unknown terminal outcomes into the existing tamoz.model.call signal, reusing the current effect record and de-duplication set.

tests_run.note: Errno::EPERM loopback fixture bind; environment-known red

blind_spots: No real OTLP collector or TLS endpoint was contacted; the adapter remains unwired in production.
Failed/unknown model-effect worker run was not constructed end to end; the source filter excludes those states, while the budget-stop omission was reproduced through the CLI fixture path.
Interactive durable ask and one-shot paths do not construct the worker journal; whether they should share this recorder is an owner contract question.
No sustained-load measurement for the reserved lane, exporter queue, or 10,000-row census.
Full rake ci and rake ci_full were not run; the loopback fixture error is environment-bound.
